content: In general, Java and C++ are the most common language in developing toolkits and systems for natural language processing tasks. For example, GATE, OpenNLP, Stanford CoreNLP and LingPipe platforms are developed by JAVA while foundation tasks and machine learning toolkits are developed by C++. CRF++, SVMLight and YAMCHA . Recently, Python becomes popular among the NLP community. In fact, many toolkits and platforms have been developed by this language, such as NLTK, PyNLPl library for Natural Language Processing.
